name: One-arm push-up
description: A full push-up on one hand with the hips square to the floor. It is as much an anti-rotation core test as a pressing one.

steps.label: Push-up
steps.cue: Body in one line, chest to the floor every rep.

steps.label: Diamond push-up
steps.cue: Elbows close to your sides on the way down.

steps.label: Archer push-up
steps.cue: Reps per side; the straight arm only guides.

steps.label: Incline one-arm push-up
steps.cue: Reps per arm; lower the surface as it gets easier.

steps.label: One-arm push-up negative
steps.cue: Reps per arm; lower for three to five seconds without twisting.

steps.label: One-arm push-up
steps.cue: Reps per arm; feet wide, hips square to the floor.
